directory_record.name: CSOAI Eunomia - published evidence feed assembly
directory_record.description: Assembly of published signal and enforcement metadata, root information and card references into one JSON feed. Payment covers assembly and cadence, not the underlying public facts, a score, a ranking or certification. Inspect source dates, signatures and correction status for each block. Current offer: 0.01 USDC per feed pull until 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z; fresh compute excluded. Check the live 402 terms. Free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/eunomia-data.
